findings.title: New table visualization discards the actual query results
findings.body: When the organization has `use-table-widget-visualization`, every dashboard table is rendered with empty columns, empty data, and empty metadata instead of the fetched `result`. Consequently, enabling the feature makes populated table widgets appear empty. Pass the result data and metadata and the configured columns to the new visualization before switching away from the existing table.

findings.title: Include the organization in the attribute query cache key
findings.body: The new React Query key contains only a constant and query options, while the query function requests an organization-specific URL. Two organizations with the same project selection (particularly the all-projects selection), date range, dataset, and attribute type therefore share a cache entry. Switching organizations can display attribute names cached from the previous organization, and simultaneous consumers can reuse the wrong request. Include the organization slug or the full endpoint path in the key, as the previous API query key did.

findings.title: Normalize recording and error timestamps before merging logs
findings.body: Error timestamps fetched from nodestore are Unix seconds, whereas rrweb recording event timestamps are Unix milliseconds. Comparing these values directly causes errors to be emitted before essentially every recording event, regardless of when they actually occurred, rather than interleaving them chronologically. The new tests use seconds for synthetic recording events and thus miss this production behavior. Convert the recording timestamp to seconds (or the error timestamp to milliseconds) for the comparison.
